S=We|V=melden|O=een onderbreking van de interne telefonie.
We report an interruption to internal telephone service.
Your team's internal telephone service is interrupted. Tell support what your team is reporting.
Melden agrees with plural we. Een onderbreking is the reported event; van de interne telefonie identifies the affected service, not its cause.
The first warning appeared at half past nine.
The first warning appeared at 9:30. Give support that observation and time.
Dutch half tien means 9:30, halfway toward ten. Verschijnen takes zijn in the perfect: is verschenen describes the warning's appearance, not a passive action.
Om half tien is de eerste waarschuwing verschenen.
The first warning appeared at half past nine.

The same actor, action, time and certainty are retained. This wording changes the first constituent or the position of the time phrase. In a Dutch main clause the finite verb stays second in constituents, with the subject after it when another constituent is fronted.
The cause is unknown at the moment.
Nobody currently knows the incident's cause. Tell your colleagues its present status.
Onbekend is an adjective after is and has no -e. Op dit moment limits the statement to current knowledge; it does not assert that no cause exists.
Can you register this report as an incident?
You have submitted a report that needs an incident record. Ask a colleague informally to register it as an incident.
Deze refers to de melding. Als incident gives the classification requested. Registreren is a bare infinitive after kun; registration is not resolution.
S=Meerdere locaties|V=hebben|O=geen verbinding met de dienst.
Several sites have no connection to the service.
Several sites cannot connect to the service. Explain the scope of the problem.
Plural locaties takes hebben. Geen negates an indefinite connection; met de dienst names what the sites cannot connect to.
We do not yet have a confirmed recovery time.
Your team still lacks a confirmed recovery time. Tell colleagues that no confirmed time is available yet.
Nog geen means not yet any. Hebben is the main verb expressing possession of information, not a perfect auxiliary here.
I have collected the times and messages.
You have collected the incident times and messages. Tell the specialist what you have already gathered.
Heb verzameld forms the perfect. The plural object tijdstippen en meldingen does not control heb; its subject ik does.
Under which number is the incident registered?
An incident has been registered, but you do not know its reference number. Ask for that number.
The whole phrase onder welk nummer comes first, followed by finite staat and subject het incident. Staat geregistreerd describes its recorded status.
The report contains only confirmed observations.
Your report includes confirmed observations only. Explain that limit on its contents.
Bevat agrees with singular de melding. Alleen limits the observations included; it does not claim that the cause is confirmed.
S=Ik|V=meld|G=dat de dienst sinds negen uur onbereikbaar is.
I report that the service has been unreachable since nine o'clock.
The service became unreachable at nine and is still unreachable. Report this continuing situation.
Sinds negen uur marks a state continuing from nine. Dutch uses present is in the dat-clause where English uses has been; is comes at that clause's end.
Only part of the service is available. Give colleagues the current availability status.
Gedeeltelijk limits availability to part of the service. Beschikbaar is a predicate adjective after is, with no -e.
The connection is still not stable.
The connection remains unstable. Tell colleagues that it is still not stable.
Nog steeds niet means still not. Niet negates stabiel; nog steeds says that the condition continues rather than describing a new failure.
We have updated the number of affected teams.
Your team has updated the count of affected teams. Announce that completed update.
Hebben bijgewerkt is the perfect of separable bijwerken. Het aantal is the object being updated; the sentence does not specify whether the count rose or fell.
The investigation has not ended. Tell colleagues that it is still ongoing.
Loopt describes an investigation being in progress, not walking. Nog marks continuation; this present statement does not report a completed investigation.
The next status update will come at eleven o'clock.
The next incident update is scheduled for eleven o'clock. Tell colleagues when it will arrive.
Komt is present tense used for a scheduled future event with om elf uur. There is no second verb or bare infinitive in this sentence.
Om elf uur komt de volgende statusupdate.
The next status update will come at eleven o'clock.

The same actor, action, time and certainty are retained. This wording changes the first constituent or the position of the time phrase. In a Dutch main clause the finite verb stays second in constituents, with the subject after it when another constituent is fronted.
A restart has not resolved the incident.
A restart was tried but did not resolve the incident. Report that unsuccessful attempt.
Heeft verholpen forms the perfect; niet negates the resolution. Verholpen is the irregular participle of verhelpen. The restart is the grammatical subject.
S=We|V=controleren|G=of alle locaties weer kunnen werken.
We check whether all sites can work again.
Your team is checking whether every site can work again. Describe the verification underway.
Of introduces an embedded whether-question. Alle locaties is its subject and kunnen werken its final verb group; checking is not yet confirmation of recovery.
The queue is decreasing at the moment.
During your incident update to colleagues, the queue is currently getting shorter. Report that improvement.
Afnemen splits as neemt ... af in this main clause. De wachtrij is singular. Op dit moment limits the observation to the current situation.
I cannot confirm an exact recovery time yet.
You cannot yet confirm an exact recovery time. Explain the limit of what you can promise.
Kan is finite with subject ik; bevestigen stays infinitive. Nog niet means not yet, leaving future confirmation possible.
The impact is smaller than half an hour ago.
Current impact is lower than it was thirty minutes ago. Compare the two points in time.
Kleiner is a comparative and takes dan. Een halfuur geleden is the earlier comparison point; the sentence does not claim that all impact has ended.
I forward the findings to the network administrator.
You are forwarding your findings to the network administrator. Tell a colleague who receives them.
Doorsturen splits as stuur ... door. Naar identifies the destination of the forwarded findings; sending information does not establish accepted ownership.
We must escalate this incident to second-line support.
Your team needs second-line support for this incident. State the required escalation.
Moeten expresses an obligation for we. Escaleren is an infinitive without te; naar de tweede lijn names the support level receiving the escalation.
Can you take over the technical analysis?
You need a colleague to take over the technical analysis. Ask them informally to do so.
Kun precedes subject je in this request. Overnemen remains joined as an infinitive; the question asks for takeover rather than claiming it already happened.
I have attached the checks performed to the report.
You have added the performed checks to the report. Tell the specialist what you included.
Heb gevoegd is perfect. De uitgevoerde controles means the checks already performed; bij de melding identifies the record they were added to.
We have not been able to solve this problem ourselves.
Your team has been unable to solve the problem without help. Explain why you need a specialist.
Hebben is the perfect auxiliary. Kunnen replaces gekund before the following infinitive oplossen in this verb cluster. Niet zelf limits the claim to solving it yourselves.
Who is the contact person for second-line support?
You do not know the contact person for second-line support. Ask who that person is.
Wie asks for the contact person's identity. Het aanspreekpunt is a noun complement after is; voor de tweede lijn identifies the relevant support level.
The specialist needs the exact times.
The specialist needs the precise incident times. Explain what information is required.
Heeft ... nodig means needs and does not form a perfect. De specialist is singular; de exacte tijdstippen is the plural information required.
S=Ik|V=leg|PART=uit|G=welke oorzaken we al hebben uitgesloten.
I explain which causes we have already ruled out.
Several possible causes have already been ruled out by your team. Explain which exclusions you are sharing.
Uitleggen splits as leg ... uit. Welke oorzaken introduces the embedded question and is its object; we is its subject. Hebben uitgesloten is its final perfect group.
The incident coordinator must confirm the escalation.
The incident coordinator is required to confirm the escalation. Tell the team whose confirmation is needed.
Moet agrees with singular de incidentcoördinator. Bevestigen is a bare infinitive; the sentence states a requirement, not completed confirmation.
S=Doorsturen|V=betekent|NEG=niet|G=dat de melding al is overgenomen.
Forwarding does not mean the report has already been taken over.
A colleague assumes forwarding a report means somebody has taken ownership. Explain why that conclusion does not follow.
Doorsturen is a nominalised infinitive functioning as the subject. Niet negates the implication; al is overgenomen refers to an already completed takeover.
The users can temporarily work through the browser.
During an outage, users can temporarily use the browser to work. Explain that available workaround.
Kunnen expresses an available way to work. Tijdelijk limits its duration, while via de browser names the route used; working remains the bare infinitive.
This workaround does not remove the cause.
A colleague thinks the workaround removes the root cause. Explain that it does not.
Wegnemen splits as neemt ... weg. De oorzaak is its object, and niet negates removal. The sentence does not deny that the workaround helps users.
The temporary solution reduces the waiting time.
During your incident update to colleagues, the temporary solution reduces users' waiting time. Explain its benefit.
Vermindert is singular present with de tijdelijke oplossing. De wachttijd is what is reduced; reduced waiting is not proof of permanent resolution.
We must restore the normal procedure later.
Your team must restore the normal procedure later. Remind colleagues of that remaining obligation.
Moeten requires bare infinitive herstellen. Later sets the restoration after the current stage; the ordinary procedure is the object to restore.
I explain the limitations of the workaround.
Colleagues need to know the workaround's limitations before using it. Say what you are explaining.
Leg ... uit is separable. Welke beperkingen introduces the embedded question, with de omweg as subject and heeft at the end.
The disruption is not permanently resolved.
A workaround helps users, but permanent resolution is still pending. Explain the incident's resolution status.
Niet definitief opgelost means not permanently resolved. Is opgelost describes a result here; the qualification leaves temporary relief possible.
We have tested the workaround with two users.
Your team tested the workaround with two users only. Report what testing has actually been done.
Hebben getest forms the perfect. Met twee gebruikers identifies the test participants; testing with two users does not establish success for everyone.
For which tasks does the temporary route work?
You need to know which tasks the temporary route supports. Ask about that scope.
Voor welke taken is the complete fronted question phrase. Werkt comes before subject de tijdelijke route; the question asks about scope, not a deadline.
The extra step takes the user more time.
The workaround adds a step that takes users extra time. Explain that cost to the user.
De extra stap is the singular subject of kost. De gebruiker identifies the person affected; meer tijd names the additional amount of time required.
G=Zodra de gewone dienst hersteld is,|V=stoppen|S=we|PP=met deze omweg.
As soon as the normal service is restored, we stop using this workaround.
Your team will stop using the workaround as soon as normal service is restored. State that condition.
Zodra means as soon as. Its clause ends in hersteld is and is followed by main-clause stoppen we. Stoppen met names the method being discontinued.
I hand the incident over to the late shift.
You are handing the incident to the late shift. Tell a colleague who receives it.
Overdragen splits as draag ... over. Aan de late dienst names the recipient; the incident is what is handed over.
Aan de late dienst draag ik het incident over.
I hand the incident over to the late shift.

The same actor, action, time and certainty are retained. This wording changes the first constituent or the position of the time phrase. In a Dutch main clause the finite verb stays second in constituents, with the subject after it when another constituent is fronted.
The handover message contains the latest confirmed status.
The handover message includes the latest confirmed status. Explain which status it contains.
Bevat takes the message as subject and the status as object. Laatste means latest here; bevestigde modifies status and does not guarantee future stability.
S=De volgende ploeg|MOD=moet|O=de verbinding|T=om zes uur|I=controleren.
The next shift must check the connection at six o'clock.
The next shift must check the connection at six o'clock. Give that timed follow-up instruction.
Moet agrees with singular de volgende ploeg. Om zes uur gives the check time; controleren remains an infinitive without te after moet.
Om zes uur moet de volgende ploeg de verbinding controleren.
The next shift must check the connection at six o'clock.

The same actor, action, time and certainty are retained. This wording changes the first constituent or the position of the time phrase. In a Dutch main clause the finite verb stays second in constituents, with the subject after it when another constituent is fronted.
We have noted the outstanding questions separately.
Your team has recorded the outstanding questions separately. Tell the next shift what you documented.
Hebben genoteerd is perfect. Openstaande means still outstanding; apart describes how the questions were recorded, not a physical location.
Who takes over contact with the user?
Someone must take over communication with the user after handover. Ask who will do that.
Wie is the question subject. Overnemen splits as neemt ... over; het contact met de gebruiker is the responsibility being transferred.
The handover has not yet been confirmed.
You sent the handover, but confirmation has not arrived. Explain its unconfirmed status.
Nog niet means not yet. Is bevestigd describes confirmation of de overdracht; the sentence does not say that no message was sent.
I explain which actions have already been performed.
You are briefing the next shift on actions already performed. Say what your explanation covers.
Leg ... uit is the main verb. Welke acties is the embedded subject; zijn uitgevoerd is a passive perfect group describing completed actions without naming their actor.
The next appointment is at the top of the message.
A colleague needs the next agreed appointment. Explain that it is listed at the top of the message.
Staat describes written information being located in a message. Bovenaan het bericht gives its position; eerstvolgende means the next upcoming appointment.
MOD=Kun|S=je|O=de overname|T=voor het einde van mijn dienst|I=bevestigen?
Can you confirm takeover before my shift ends?
Your shift is about to end, and a colleague needs to confirm taking ownership before then. Ask for that confirmation informally.
Voor het einde van mijn dienst sets a deadline before the shift ends. Kun ... bevestigen is a request; it does not announce that confirmation has arrived.
Until takeover is confirmed, I remain responsible.
You retain responsibility until the new owner confirms takeover. State how long you remain responsible.
Totdat marks the endpoint. The fronted clause ends in bevestigd is; main-clause blijf precedes ik. Verantwoordelijk is a predicate adjective.
S=Ik|V=ben|C=het vaste aanspreekpunt voor dit incident.
I am the regular contact person for this incident.
You will remain the regular contact person for this incident. Identify your ongoing role.
Ik ben identifies your role; het vaste aanspreekpunt is a noun complement, not an object receiving an action. Voor dit incident limits the role to this incident.
Who follows up the recovery check tomorrow?
Tomorrow's recovery check needs a follow-up owner. Ask who will follow it up.
Wie is the question subject. Opvolgen splits as volgt ... op; morgen sets the time for following up the recovery check.
We must confirm recovery with the affected teams.
Your team must verify recovery with the affected teams. State that remaining requirement.
Moeten is finite with we, and bevestigen stays infinitive. Bij de getroffen teams identifies where confirmation is to be sought, not who has already confirmed it.
S=Geen nieuwe meldingen|V=betekent|NEG=niet|G=dat iedereen weer kan werken.
No new reports does not mean everyone can work again.
No new reports have arrived, and a colleague assumes everyone can work again. Explain why that inference is unsafe.
Geen nieuwe meldingen is treated as one situation in this model: the absence of new reports. Niet rejects the inference, and iedereen is singular with kan in the embedded clause.
The coordinator has assigned follow-up to our team.
During your incident update to colleagues, the coordinator assigned follow-up to your team. Report that completed assignment.
Heeft toegewezen is the perfect of separable toewijzen. Aan ons team names the recipient; ons agrees with singular het team.
The incident remains open until the post-check.
The incident will remain open until the post-check. Tell colleagues about that closure boundary.
Blijft describes a continuing state, with open as its complement. Tot de nacontrole marks the boundary; it does not by itself guarantee closure immediately afterwards.
S=Ik|V=controleer|G=of de gebruiker de gewone werkwijze weer kan volgen.
I check whether the user can follow the normal procedure again.
You are checking whether the user can follow the normal procedure again. Describe that functional recovery check.
Of introduces a whether-question. De gebruiker is singular with kan; volgen stays infinitive in the final group kan volgen. Weer means again.
We will discuss the cause and follow-up actions separately.
Your team will discuss the cause and follow-up actions separately. Tell colleagues about that planned discussion.
Zullen is the finite future/intention verb with we. Bespreken stays infinitive, and apart says the discussion is separate; it is not an assertion of completed analysis.
MOD=Kun|S=je|O=de bevestiging van herstel|L=in het ticket|I=zetten?
Can you put the recovery confirmation in the ticket?
Recovery has been confirmed and needs to be documented in the ticket. Ask a colleague informally to add the confirmation.
Kun comes before je. In het ticket gives the destination for the confirmation, and zetten remains an infinitive; recording evidence is the requested action.
Responsibility does not disappear when the service is restored.
Service is restored, but follow-up responsibilities remain. Explain that restoration does not make responsibility disappear.
Niet negates verdwijnt. Als introduces the restoration condition and ends in hersteld is; restored service and remaining responsibility can coexist.
